title: A name in the ashes
text: A survivor searches a ruined doorway for the mark their family carved there. You help preserve it on a scrap of timber.

title: Tracks beside the road
text: A young traveler has lost the safe path beneath the ash. You show them the camp lights and walk beside them until they can see.

title: The herbalist's marker
text: A faded ribbon marks a patch of healing herbs. You replace the ribbon so the next gatherer will find it without disturbing the roots.

title: An unfinished prayer
text: A pilgrim asks whether a broken shrine can still be sacred. Together you clear a place where weary people can rest.

title: Shelter beneath the beacon
text: A scout has left a blanket beside a frozen shelter. You repair its loose door and leave a sign pointing toward the beacon.

title: Letters from the tide
text: A sealed packet washes ashore. You dry the letters and entrust them to the next boat bound for the camp.
